scope: Saved plan readback, structural checks and art-direction constraint review; no images generated.

constraint_review.copy: The only delegated printed text is 서로 다른 속도, once per poster; the common constraints prohibit incidental text, supporting copy, logos, numbering and printed direction names.
constraint_review.artifact: Five separate single flat opaque portrait posters are assigned, each within one maker role.
constraint_review.substantive_visuals: M1: still body versus moving passage. M2: equal retained moments with unequal reach. M3: unequal meshed wheels and angular travel. M4: connected roots and unequal growth states. M5: simultaneous pours with unequal descent and pooling. Each image relation remains meaningful without glyphs.
constraint_review.distinct_systems: Environmental lateral observation; open-field translational overprint; radial cut-paper mechanism; rooted ink growth; vertical material flow. Typography respectively observes, establishes an origin, counterbalances a mesh, inhabits a growth boundary, and follows descent.
constraint_review.independence: No common title-object-footer partition, layout proportions, fixed palette or prior generated reference is assigned. Makers retain practical composition decisions within their own relations.
constraint_review.guidance_only: Concepts and production constraints are internal directions, not complete image prompts or added printed copy. No scores are present.
